title: Protoxon SMP
description: A Vanilla+ survival server. With small quality of life add-ons and a deeper world with more structures and dungeons to explore. Join our friendly active community of players! Fresh world just released!!
body:
A Vanilla+ survival server. With small quality of life add-ons and a deeper world with more structures and dungeons to explore. Join our friendly active community of players! Fresh world just released!!

World depth extended to Y -129 with deeper caves
Custom structures and dungeons scattered across the world
Vanilla-style gameplay with light enhancements
Friendly, active community
